# Logan Plaster Repairs

> Plasterer based in Eagleby, QLD (Logan City, south of Brisbane). Owner: Nick Prozorovskiy. Call or SMS: 0405 844 343 (+61405844343). Fastest contact: SMS photos or call.

## Services

### Plaster and plasterboard repairs
- Holes, dents and cracks in walls and ceilings
- Door handle holes
- Ceiling patches and sagging ceiling repair
- Water damage repairs to walls and ceilings
- Mould-damaged plasterboard replaced
- Larger damaged sections cut out and replaced
- Patching after electricians, plumbers and aircon installers

### Ceilings and wall lining
- Ceiling resheeting
- Wall resheeting and relining
- Villaboard installation in bathrooms and wet areas
- Square set ceilings and corners

### Cornice and bulkheads
- Cornice installation and replacement
- Cornice on new bulkheads around kitchens
- Bulkheads over kitchens, laundries and cupboards
- Bulkheads around ducts

### Walls, doorways and openings
- New stud walls and partitions
- Moving or removing non-load-bearing walls
- Closing up old doorways
- New doorways and openings
- Moving a doorway
- Cavity sliding doors framed, sheeted and set
- Shaped and curved openings, e.g. a ceiling opening for a home lift
- Removing old plaster cupboards or structures, then patching walls and fitting cornice

### Feature work
- Media walls and TV niches
- Fireplace surrounds
- VJ boards (VJ panelling) installed or replaced

### Finishing and renovations
- Setting (stopping) and sanding, ready for paint
- Prep for painters
- Help with renovations and layout changes for homeowners, renovators, builders and property managers
- Invoice work for insurance and water damage jobs

## Prices
- Small hole in a wall from $350, materials included.
- Other jobs: free quote from photos.
- We can work on invoice for insurance and water damage jobs.

## How to get a quote
Text 2-3 photos (close-up and from further back), your suburb and a short description of the job to 0405 844 343. A price is sent back by text, usually the same evening.

## Not offered
- Painting
- Same-day urgent call-outs
- Work on load-bearing walls (needs an engineer or builder)

## Service area
Eagleby (base), Beenleigh, Mount Warren Park, Windaroo, Edens Landing, Holmview, Bethania, Loganholme, Yatala, Daisy Hill and nearby Logan suburbs, QLD, Australia.
